repos_data.description: Market-making strategy that placed #2 in Paradigm's Prediction Market Challenge. 110 iterations, 8 hours.

Open-source AI trading signal engine with a public, inspectable outcome ledger. Our own signals lose money on average after modeled costs — we publish every row anyway. Multi-timeframe TA, backtester, paper trading, Telegram/Discord alerts. Self-hosted, Next.js + PostgreSQL, MIT.

Scores hedgeable concentrated-liquidity pools by a spike-resistant fee floor with real CL impermanent-loss math, then backtests pool rotation against the no-lookahead ex-ante benchmark. Keyless, Python stdlib only.
Realistic limit-order fill simulator for options credit/debit spreads. Engine-agnostic, data-source-agnostic.
PyTorch research stack for ML multi-factor trading: 213 factors, bias correction, portfolio optimization, and vectorized backtesting.
BTC order book microstructure analysis: OBI, CVD, and spread statistics from 38 days of Binance data
RL stock selection for China A-share — bundled polars-native factor library (105 Alpha101 + 191 GTJA Alpha191 = 296 factors), board-aware price limits, GPU train + ONNX CPU infer, MIT-licensed.

Reproducible crypto-trading benchmark data: exchange API latency (p50/p95/p99), real cost-to-trade (fee + spread + slippage), and x402 blockchain settlement latency. Updated automatically. CC BY 4.0. Behind fillbench.com
